# AI Engineer Role Checker

> A free scorecard for evaluating readiness for agent-era engineering work after AI makes code generation cheap.

AI Engineer Role Checker helps engineers and teams assess whether they are moving from code production to higher-leverage skills: bottleneck awareness, review systems, specification, context, product judgment, and accountability.

- Main app: https://ai-engineer-role-checker.pages.dev/
- API endpoint: https://ai-engineer-role-checker.pages.dev/api/score
- Category: AI engineering, developer productivity, engineering career strategy
- Cost: free

## What the app evaluates

- Bottleneck awareness
- Agent-written code review skill
- Specification and context quality
- Product and human judgment
- Agent-native learning path
